Commentary.Commentary: We are back for Namibia's reply. United Arab Emirates players have made their way out in the middle. Michael Van Lingen and Stephan Baard walk in with their blades. Basil Hameed to start with the ball. Here we go.
... The Run Chase ...

Right then, Namibia have a job on their hands if they want to progress further in this edition of Men’s T20 World Cup. UAE's dreams have already been shattered but would give it their all to take a consolation win here and play spoilsport. Chase coming up in a bit…

Basil Hameed is in for a quick chat. He says that they started a bit slow but when they reached to the 15th over, the pitch got better to bat. Adds that it becomes easier to play with the old ball and Waseem was really good. Further says that it is a decent total and applauds Karthik Meiyappan for his Hat-Trick in the previous game.

Namibia began well with the new ball. In fact, they had the opposition under the pump for most of the innings. They did not let the batters find boundaries at will and kept the run-rate in check. Bernard Scholtz was impressive with the ball going at 5.50 RPO with a wicket under his belly. David Wiese and Ben Shikongo chipped in a wicket each. Although, Namibia will hope that the last two overs won’t come back to haunt them.

UAE openers started off cautiously managing not to lose any wicket in the Powerplay. As the Powerplay ended, Vriitya Aravind was dismissed in his quest to up the ante. Muhammad Waseem then took charge and started to get a move on with skipper, Rizwan. Hameed’s cameo towards the end was one of the biggest positives for UAE.

Phew! What a fight back by UAE. They have managed to rack up 33 runs in the final two overs to take their tally close to the 150-run mark. They are certainly heading into the break with the momentum on their side. Namibia dominated the proceedings but got derailed in the death overs.
Goes fuller and on off, Basil Hameed flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace. United Arab Emirates end their innings for 148/3.
FOUR! On a length and outside off, Basil Hameed scoops it through third man for a boundary!
This one lands down leg, Basil Hameed shuffles across and looks to play at it but misses.
SIX! Slightly shorter and on off, Basil Hameed pulls it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. This is turning out to be an expensive over for Namibia!

Touch fuller and outside off, Chundangapoyil Rizwan cuts it in the gap between backward point and short third man. The fielder chases it and just stops it before the fence. Excellent fielding. They collect three runs.
SIX! A full toss on leg, Chundangapoyil Rizwan uses the pace of the ball and flicks it over backward square leg for a biggie. Excellent shot!
Fuller one this time, Basil Hameed defends it straight towards the bowler.
SIX! Up and over. Shorter and on off, Basil Hameed pulls it over deep square leg for a maximum!
A yorker and on off, Basil Hameed digs it to mid on and collect two. Good running!
Outside off, Basil Hameed looks to scoop it but misses.
Slightly shorter on off, Basil Hameed looks to pull it but gets a hit on his ribs. Dot.
FOUR! Good shot. On a length and outside off, Basil Hameed uses the pace of the ball and guides it to third man for a boundary!
Fuller and on off, Basil Hameed eases it to covers for one.
Another one outside off, Basil Hameed moves forward to loft it but misses again. Three dots in a row!
Play and a miss again. This one lands outside off as well, Basil Hameed looks to cut it but misses again.
Serves it outside off, Basil Hameed looks to loft it but misses.
On a length and on off, Chundangapoyil Rizwan slaps it to point for one.
Outside off this time, Chundangapoyil Rizwan looks to play at it but misses.
Basil Hameed is the new man in. Also, a change in bowler for Namibia as JJ Smit is brought back into the attack.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Slightly shorter and on off, slower too. Alishan Sharafu dances down the track to play at it but it a well directed slower delivery which leaves Alishan Sharafu with no much room. He later, tries to go over the keeper's head but there is not much pace to work with. The ball goes behind towards Zane Green who takes an excellent catch diving to his right.
Commentary.Howout: c Zane Green b David Wiese

Commentary.Commentary: Good length and on leg, Alishan Sharafu pulls it towards deep square leg for a brace.
A single as this is guided towards short third man.
Length ball and down leg, Alishan Sharafu flicks it to mid-wicket for one again.
Good length this time, this is played towards point for a single.
FOUR! Slightly shorter and outside off, Chundangapoyil Rizwan looks to slap it but gets a top edge. The ball races away the third man fence. Lucky boundary!
On a length, on off. Chundangapoyil Rizwan taps it to point for one.
Bowls it outside off, Chundangapoyil Rizwan looks to defend it but misses.
Fuller and on middle, Chundangapoyil Rizwan flicks it to backward square leg for a brace again. Excellent running between the wickets!
This one goes down leg, Chundangapoyil Rizwan flicks it to short fine leg and calls for two. The fielder is quick to throw towards the keeper who fails to grab it. Close!
On off again, Alishan Sharafu guides it to backward point and gets off the mark.
On a length and on off, Chundangapoyil Rizwan eases it towards point and calls for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the strikers end but misses.
Alishan Sharafu walks in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Muhammad Waseem trudges back to the pavilion just after racking up his half-century. He is devastated. Ben Shikongo comes into the attack and finds the breakthrough. Namibia will hope to tighten the screws here. It is a short ball, outside off, although not much pace on offer. Muhammad Waseem hangs back and looks to cut it away but is unable to clear the fielder at short third man. Ruben Trumpelmann there takes a sharp catch above his head.
Commentary.Howout: c Ruben Trumpelmann b Ben Shikongo

Commentary.Commentary: Quite short, around off. Rizwan works it to backward point for one.

FIFTY FOR WASEEM! An incredible knock just when his side needed it the most. Touch short, on middle. Waseem tucks it to mid-wicket and crosses. He gets an appaluse from the crowd but he know his job is still half done here.
A risky run! Fuller, on off. Rizwan blocks it towards short extra covers and scampers across for one.
FOUR! Rizwan is finding his groove now. It is fuller, on middle and leg. Rizwan flicks it down to fine leg and gets a boundary.
United Arab Emirates will be hoping to get some quick runs on the board now. The partnership is looking good as of now. Namibia would be hoping to break this as soon as possible.
Good length, in the channel. Waseem dabs it down to third man for one.
A single to end the over! A length ball, outside off. Waseem taps it o covers and scampers across. A good over for UAE, 12 runs off it. Also, the stand moves to 50 now.
A quick single now as this full delivery is driven into covers.
FOUR! Gorgeous shot by Rizwan! It is full, on fourth stump. In the arc for Rizwan, he gets under it and lofts it over mid off. A couple of bounces into the ropes.
A low full toss, around middle. Waseem whips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Very full, wide outside off. Waseem reaches out and slashes it to deep point for two more.
A length ball, outside off. Waseem punches it to sweeper cover off his back foot. They take a couple. It could've been curtains for Waseem if the throw was a good one.
WIDE! Jan Frylinck comes 'round the wicket and spills it way outside the tramline. Waseem lets it be and the umpire spreads his arms.
Slightly short, wide of off. Waseem hangs back and gets a better connection this time. He cuts it to backward point and scampers across for a quick single.
Flatter, outside off. Waseem chops it to the off side.
Slightly shorter and down leg, Chundangapoyil Rizwan flicks it to square leg for one.
On middle, worked back to the bowler.
On off, defended out.
Fuller, outside off. Rizwan works it to wide of long off for a couple.
SIX! BANG! Just what the doctor ordered for UAE. A short ball, on off. Waseem stands tall and smokes it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
A length ball, on off. Waseem blocks it out solidly.
A short ball this time, outside off. Waseem gets on his toes and cuts it over backward point. It lands safely and they take two runs.
Off-pace delivery yet again, wide of off. Waseem looks to chase it but misses.
On a length, outside off, a slower one. Waseem gets a small nick on it. The batters take two and the ball runs into the off side.
This one is on the pads, Rizwan stays back and flicks it square on the leg side. They cross.

Play and a miss! On a length, outside off. Waseem shuffles and looks to hoick it across the line. He fails to get any connection on it, as the ball dies as it reaches the keeper. A tidy over fom Ruben Trumpelmann comes to an end.
Full length, around off. Rizwan opens the face and plays it to point. One taken.
A length ball, angled across the right-hander, in the channel. Rizwan looks to have a poke at it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Much fuller, on off stump. Muhammad Waseem drives it to extra cover and gets to the other side.
On a length, wide of off. Muhammad Waseem plays it late and guides it down to third man for a brace.
A length ball, around middle. This one straightens a bit after hitting the deck. Muhammad Waseem uses the depth of the crease to block it back to the bowler.

Drinks! United Arab Emirates are off to a slow start and they will look to catch up some pace now. They will have to look for a solid partnership now. Namibia will be hoping to grab some quick wickets and restrict the United Arab Emirates to a low total. The scoreboard reads 58/1 as of now. Ruben Trumpelmann comes into the attack now.
Slower and short on off, Chundangapoyil Rizwan guides it over the keeper for a couple of runs. The third man fielder does the cleaning work. An expensive over by Jan Frylinck.
Short of a length on off, Muhammad Waseem clips it to deep square leg for a single.

SIX! THUMPED! Slower outside off, Muhammad Waseem advances down the track, fetches it from outside off and deposits it towards the sight screens for his first six. Muhammad Waseem is starting to get a move on here.
Off cutter on off, Chundangapoyil Rizwan works it to deep cover and gets off the mark.
Slightly shorter and on off, slower too. Muhammad Waseem works it to short mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Full on off, Muhammad Waseem shimmies down the track and lofts it over extra cover for a much-needed boundary.
Bowls it outside off, Bernard Scholtz cuts it towards backward point for one. A single to end the over.
Goes fuller and on off, Chundangapoyil Rizwan knocks it to long off for one.
Tossed up, on off. Chundangapoyil Rizwan eases it to the fielder at backward point.
Fuller and on off, this is flicked towards square leg for one.
Chundangapoyil Rizwan is off the mark instantly. It is full and on off. Rizwan eases it to long off for one.
Chundangapoyil Rizwan comes in at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Namibia finally have a breakthrough in the game. This one lands faster and outside off with a hint of turn, Vriitya Aravind gets on his knee and looks to loft it but gets a thick outside edge. The ball carries towards backward point. Michael Van Lingen goes backward and takes it over his head. United Arab Emirates lose their first wicket!
Commentary.Howout: c Michael Van Lingen b Bernard Scholtz

Commentary.Commentary: Full on off, Vriitya Aravind gets forward and plays it to mid-off for a single.
Peach of a delivery! Off cutter by Frylinck goes just past the outside edge as Aravind tried to work it on the onside.
Back of a length on off, Vriitya Aravind looks to punch it through the covers but gets beaten.
Short on off, Muhammad Waseem guides to third man for a run.
Fuller length and outside off. Waseem pokes at it and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Full outside off, Vriitya Aravind gets forward and drives it to the right of mid-off. Michael Van Lingen prevents a boundary by diving it to his right.
On off, this is played towards long off for one.
FOUR! Goes fuller and outside off, Vriitya Aravind cuts it through the diving fielder at backward point for a boundary. United Arab Emirates need more of these!
Fuller and on off, Vriitya Aravind eases it towards the fielder at mid off. Dot again.
Flighted up, on off. This is defended back towards the bowler.
Bowls it fuller and outside off, Muhammad Waseem taps it to covers. They cross.
Tossed up, on middle, Muhammad Waseem defends it to mid on.
Change. Bernard Scholtz (1-0-8-0) is back into the attack now.
Short on off, Muhammad Waseem opens the bat face and guides it to the left of backward point. The fielder dives to his left and parries it to short third-man.
Full going away from the batter, Muhammad Waseem gets beaten on the drive.
Full outside off, Muhammad Waseem lofts it over mid-off for a couple of runs. Erasmus at mid off runs backwards and keeps it to two.
Wide! Banged in short down the leg side, Muhammad Waseem lets it go.
Back of a length on off, Muhammad Waseem knocks it off the front foot to point.
Back of a length outside off, Vriitya Aravind cuts it to deep backward point and takes a single.
Full outside off, Vriitya Aravind goes for the full fledged drive and gets beaten on the outside edge.
A dot again to finish with. On a length and just outside leg, Muhammad Waseem uses his feet to loft it but misses. That was close. Just a run off the over!
Back of a length and on leg, Vriitya Aravind eases it to mid on for one.
Touch fuller this time, this is defended back towards the bowler. Four dots in a row now!
Length ball on off, defended out.
Slightly shorter with some extra bounce, Vriitya Aravind gets on his knee to scoop it but misses.
Good length and on middle, Vriitya Aravind defends it as it bounces off the deck. He wanted a quick single but the fielder was quick enough to cover it.
Back of a length on off, Vriitya Aravind taps it off the backfoot to mid-off and sets off for a quick single. Gerhard Erasmus hits at the non-striker's end but Aravind is well in.
Full on off, Vriitya Aravind defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Vriitya Aravind cuts this one fine between backward point and short third man for a boundary. Smart batting by Aravind.
Cutter on off, Vriitya Aravind punches it to covers but doesn't find the gap.
Short on off, Vriitya Aravind advances and defends on the offside. Waseem sets off for a single but gets sent back by Aravind.
Short on off, Vriitya Aravind defends it on the off side.
Fuller and on off again, Muhammad Waseem taps it but finds the fielder at point.
On off, defended to covers.
SIX! Excellent shot. Fuller one on off, Muhammad Waseem gets on his knees and slog sweeps it over square leg for a biggie!
Tosses it on off, this is defended to short mid-wicket.
Slightly shorter, on off. Vriitya Aravind punches it between extra covers and mid off for one.
Tossed up, on off. Muhammad Waseem eases it to mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Sharp bounce by Wiese, the ball hits Arvind on the gloves as he tried to play it fine and rolls through to the keeper. David Wiese starts off with a 5-run over.
Short on middle, Vriitya Aravind clips it to mid-wicket.
Wide! David Wiese drifts down the legside and it is wided.
Back of a length on off, Vriitya Aravind punches it off the backfoot to deep backward point for a couple of runs.
Full outside off, Vriitya Aravind drives it with a straight bat to mid-off..
Short on off, Muhammad Waseem drops it on the off side and sets off for a single.
Short of a length outside off, Vriitya Aravind plays it off the backfoot to short-third man for a single.
David Wiese to share the new ball.
Fuller one on leg, Vriitya Aravind flicks it to square leg for one.
Touch fuller and outside off, Vriitya Aravind gets on his knee and eases it to point for a brace.
Wide! Another one outside leg, Vriitya Aravind leaves it alone.
On off, this is defended towards the off side.
Wide! Another length ball outside leg, Vriitya Aravind lets it go.
On a length and down leg, it nips in as well. Vriitya Aravind flicks it towards the leg side. That was close!
Length again, outside off. Muhammad Waseem taps it to backward point and gets off the mark. They collect one.
Starts with a length ball on middle, Muhammad Waseem defends it towards the off side. A dot to start with.

So we are done with all the pre-match proceedings. The Namibia players are seen to be in a huddle near the ropes before they take the field. Muhammad Waseem and Vriitya Aravind walk out to open for United Arab Emirates. Ruben Trumpelmann to start with the new ball.
Right then. Both the teams now making their way out on the field. All the players will line up for their respective national anthems. It will be UAE's first followed by Namibia's.

Gerhard Erasmus, the Namibian skipper says that toss won’t matter with the dew settling in later. Informs that Ruben Trumpelmann is in the side tonight in place of Divan la Cock. Says that they are going to go out there and enjoy tonight. Ends by adding that it’s all in their hands.

Chundangapoyil Rizwan, the captain of United Arab Emirates is in for a chat. He starts by saying that they will bat first. Adds the ball starts to do something in the latter stages and hence have opted to bat first here. Informs that there are three changes to the side as well.

Namibia (Playing XI) - Michael Van Lingen, Stephan Baard, Gerhard Erasmus (C), Jan Frylinck, Nicol Loftie-Eaton, JJ Smit, David Wiese, Zane Green (WK), Bernard Scholtz, Ben Shikongo, Ruben Trumpelmann (In for Divan la Cock).

United Arab Emirates (Playing XI) - Muhammad Waseem, Chundangapoyil Rizwan (C), Ahmed Raza (In for Aryan Lakra), Vriitya Aravind (WK), Alishan Sharafu (In for Chirag Suri), Basil Hameed, Fahad Nawaz (In for Kashif Daud), Aayan Khan, Karthik Meiyappan, Junaid Siddique, Zahoor Khan.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour United Arab Emirates. They have opted to BAT first.

Update - Sri Lanka have registered their win against Netherlands and have also booked a spot for them in the Super 12s. Now, if Namibia gets a win over UAE, they can make it through to the Super 12s if they have a better NRR than the Dutch. UAE surely can make an impact in this decisive encounter.
